verses.en: The wicked flee when no man pursueth: but the righteous are bold as a lion.
verses.sm: O le amio leaga; ma le faamaoni > E sosola E amio leaga, a o leai sé tuliloa; a o e amiotonu, e pei o le leona taanoa i latou ona le mata'u.

verses.en: For the transgression of a land many are the princes thereof: but by a man of understanding and knowledge the state thereof shall be prolonged.
verses.sm: O le fouvale o le nuu e toatele ai ona alii; a o le tagata mafaufau ma le poto, e faaualoaina ai le malo.

verses.en: A poor man that oppresseth the poor is like a sweeping rain which leaveth no food.
verses.sm: O le tagata mativa o le ua faasaua i e matitiva, o le timuga e palasi ifo lea, a e le tupu ai ni mea e “ai.

verses.en: They that forsake the law praise the wicked: but such as keep the law contend with them.
verses.sm: O e tuulafoai le tulafono, latou te vivii i le ua amio leaga; a oe tausiusi i le tulafono, latou te tiga lava ia i latou.

verses.en: Evil men understand not judgment: but they that seek the LORD understand all things.
verses.sm: O tagata amio leaga latou te le lagona le faamasinopa; a o e saili i le ALII ua latou lagona mea uma.

verses.en: Better is the poor that walketh in his uprightness, than he that is perverse in his ways, though he be rich.
verses.sm: E sili ona lelei o le tagata mativa ua savali i lana amiotonu, i le ua faapiopio ona ala, a o le mauoa ia.

verses.en: Whoso keepeth the law is a wise son: but he that is a companion of riotous men shameth his father.
verses.sm: O le ua anaana i le tulafono, o le atalii mafaufau O ia; a o le ua aumea ma e ‘ai tetele, e ma ai lona tama ona o ia.

verses.en: He that by usury and unjust gain increaseth his substance, he shall gather it for him that will pity the poor.
verses.sm: O le ua faatele ana oloa i se totogi faasili, po o se mea faasili, na te faaputuina ia mea mo le ua alofa i e matitiva.

verses.en: He that turneth away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer shall be abomination.
verses.sm: O le ua liliu ese ona taliga a e le faalogologo i le tulafono, e inosia lana lava tatalo.

verses.en: Whoso causeth the righteous to go astray in an evil way, he shall fall himself into his own pit: but the upright shall have good things in possession.
verses.sm: O le ua faasese i e amio sa‘o i le ala leaga, e pati o ia i lana lava lua; a o e ua sao ona lelei, e fai mo latou tofi mea lelei.

verses.en: The rich man is wise in his own conceit; but the poor that hath understanding searcheth him out.
verses.sm: O le tagata mauoa, e poto o ia i lona manatu; a o le tagata mativa le ua mafaufau, na te suesue ia te ia.

verses.en: When righteous men do rejoice, there is great glory: but when the wicked rise, a man is hidden.
verses.sm: A olioli è amiotonu, e tele ai le manuia; a e a tulai mai e amio leaga, ua lalafi ai tagata.

verses.en: He that covereth his sins shall not prosper: but whoso confesseth and forsaketh them shall have mercy.
verses.sm: O le ua ufiufi lona solitulafono, e le manuia o ia; a o le ua faaali ma lafoaiina, e alofagia o ia.

verses.en: Happy is the man that feareth alway: but he that hardeneth his heart shall fall into mischief.
verses.sm: Amuia le tagata ua le aunoa ona mataʻu o ia; a o le ua faamaaa lona loto, e pau o ia i le leaga.

verses.en: As a roaring lion, and a ranging bear; so is a wicked ruler over the poor people.
verses.sm: O le leona tagi ma le urosa fia ‘ai, o le alii amio leaga lea ua pule i le nuu mativa.

verses.en: The prince that wanteth understanding is also a great oppressor: but he that hateth covetousness shall prolong his days.
verses.sm: O le alii ua leai sona mafaufau, ua tele ana sauaga; a o lē ʻinoʻino i le matapeapea, e faalevalevaina ona aso.

verses.en: A man that doeth violence to the blood of any person shall flee to the pit; let no man stay him.
verses.sm: O le tagata ua faasaua ua fasioti ai le tasi, e sola atu lava ia, e oo i le lua; aua le taofia o ia.

verses.en: Whoso walketh uprightly shall be saved: but he that is perverse in his ways shall fall at once.
verses.sm: O le ua savali ma lana amio ua sao, e faaolaina o ia; a o le ua faapiopio i ala e lua, e pau o ia i se tasio ia ala.

verses.en: He that tilleth his land shall have plenty of bread: but he that followeth after vain persons shall have poverty enough.
verses.sm: O le galue i lona fanua, e ma“ona o iai mea e “ai; a ole mulimuli i tagata faatauvaa, e ma'ona o ia i le mativa.

verses.en: A faithful man shall abound with blessings: but he that maketh haste to be rich shall not be innocent.
verses.sm: O le tagata faamaoni, e tele mea e manuia ai o ia; ao le ua faataalise ona mauoa, e le faasaoina o ia.

verses.en: To have respect of persons is not good: for for a piece of bread that man will transgress.
verses.sm: O le faailogaina o tagata, e le lelei lea; e solitulafono lea tagata ona o le fasi areto.

verses.en: He that hasteth to be rich hath an evil eye, and considereth not that poverty shall come upon him.
verses.sm: E faataalise i le fia mauoa le tagata mataoge; a e le iloa e ia e oo mai le mativa ia te ia.

verses.en: He that rebuketh a man afterwards shall find more favour than he that flattereth with the tongue.
verses.sm: O le ua aoai i le tagata, r mulimuli ane e alofagia o ia e sili i le ua tautala faaoleole.

verses.en: Whoso robbeth his father or his mother, and saith, It is no transgression; the same is the companion of a destroyer.
verses.sm: O le na te faoa mea a lona tamá ma lona tina, a e fai ane o ia, E le se solitulafono lea; e faatasia O la ma le tagata na te faataumaoi mea.

verses.en: He that is of a proud heart stirreth up strife: but he that putteth his trust in the LORD shall be made fat.
verses.sm: O le ua fefete lona loto, na te faatupuir.a le misa; a o lē faatuatua i le ALII, e matuá ma'ona lava ia.

verses.en: He that trusteth in his own heart is a fool: but whoso walketh wisely, he shall be delivered.
verses.sm: O le ua faatuatua i lona lava loto, o le vale ia; a o lé savali ma le poto, e laveaiina o ia.

verses.en: He that giveth unto the poor shall not lack: but he that hideth his eyes shall have many a curse.
verses.sm: O le ua foai atu i le tagata mativa, e le mativa o ia; a o lē “alo ai ona fofoga e láufetruina o ia.

verses.en: When the wicked rise, men hide themselves: but when they perish, the righteous increase.
verses.sm: A tulai mai E amio leaga ua lalafi ai tagata; a e a fano i latou ua faatoateleina E amiotonu.
